subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “After clear signs and return boxes were added, the program worked better.”?
options: The trash still came from homes, shops, and streets.
By Wednesday, many bags had cups hanging from the side.
They bought cold drinks in plastic cups almost every afternoon.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The trash still came from homes, shops, and streets.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「By Wednesday, many bags had cups hanging from the side.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They bought cold drinks in plastic cups almost every afternoon.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「After clear signs and return boxes were added, the program worked better. Trash from disposable cups decreased.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「After clear signs and return boxes were added, the program worked better. Trash from disposable cups decreased.」，答案為「Trash from disposable cups decreased.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Trash from disposable cups decreased.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
